body: Create lib/remote-sdk-worker.mjs exporting isRemoteSdkAvailable, buildRemoteSdkBridgeScript, runRemoteSdkTicket, and runRemoteSdkPlan for wave-ordered cloud-VM ticket execution with bounded concurrency, timeout teardown, dry-run planning, and graceful { ok: false, kind, error } degradation. Add offline fixture test/fixtures/fake-remote-sdk and test/remote-sdk-worker.test.mjs. Verify: node --test test/remote-sdk-worker.test.mjs
title: google-antigravity Python SDK Cloud-Bursting Worker Adapter
